capabilities: visualize your life as a week-by-week heart grid from birth date
write, browse, search and edit daily journal entries in a feed
add colored events and pastel life-zone periods to the grid
track exercises from daily notes in a monthly heatmap with stats
export and import a JSON backup compatible with the Android app
disambiguation: Not a date or scheduling calendar; it visualizes your entire lifespan as a grid of weekly heart cells.
extras: README notes the plugin was awaiting community-catalog review at the time of writing; author offers support via Telegram. The zones key in exports is ignored by the Android app for compatibility.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see your whole life as a week-by-week visual calendar tied to your daily notes.

relations.evidence: one-click export for the Life Calendar Android app
Based on the idea of Life in Weeks from WaitButWhy

summary: Life-in-weeks grid of heart-shaped cells with a built-in journal, events, life zones, an exercise tracker, and JSON export to an Android app.
